description: Overrides on top of homelab's shared renovate-global.json (which does the classification). Enable the KUBERNETES manager for deploy/ + pinDigests so Renovate PINS then BUMPS the operator's OWN image by digest — that is what makes a new build actually ROLL: ArgoCD tracks this repo's master, and a `:latest` manifest never changes so it never redeploys. Digest bumps ride the global `automerge` lane (renovate-approve -> auto-merge), so each deploy is a revertable commit (paper trail + rollback) and the silent `:latest` shift is gone.

packageRules.description: Pin + bump the operator's own image (rebuilt from this repo's master) by digest.
